sense: the money you are paid for your job

pins.definition: Regular money paid to someone for their work, usually every month.
The fixed amount of money an employee receives regularly, usually monthly, for their work.
Regular payment made by an employer to an employee for employment.

situation: An office worker opening a crisp paper envelope on the first of the month to find his regular monthly pay inside.
subject: the regular monthly payment
brief: A man at a wooden office desk holds a crisp open envelope from which a neat stack of bank notes is drawn, perfectly uniform and banded. A calendar on the wall clearly shows the first day of a new month, and morning light strikes the payment directly.
